premise.claim: urllib3 2.7.0 (pinned in test/gha-e2e/mooncake/image/requirements.txt on base) is affected by GHSA-8988-9cw3-xx77, GHSA-vxq7-64xx-v4gw and GHSA-gh4c-6fx4-qh6g; 2.8.0 fixes them.
premise.reportedComponent: test-only Mooncake e2e image (urllib3 via requests via mooncake-transfer-engine-non-cuda)
premise.evidence: Advisory API: all three GHSAs list '< 2.8.0' as affected, patched 2.8.0 (results/ghsa-affected-ranges.txt). Repro of GHSA-vxq7-64xx-v4gw: a 4MiB unterminated chunk-size line is fully buffered (peak 8.6MB traced) under 2.7.0, while 2.8.0 raises ProtocolError after 64KiB (results/p0-urllib3-2.7.0.txt, results/p0-urllib3-2.8.0.txt). Exposure caveat: mooncake 0.3.12.post1 never imports requests/urllib3 in its python code, so in-image runtime exposure is nil; the bump is hygiene.

integration.cmd: bash docs/verification/mooncake-urllib3-bump/scripts/l2_full_lockfile_resolve.sh <requirements.txt> && python3 docs/verification/mooncake-urllib3-bump/scripts/l2_runtime_smoke.py (in a venv with requests==2.34.2 urllib3==2.8.0)

findings.note: Not a defect: verifies the bumped pin's hashes match PyPI digests, requires_python admits the image's python 3.12, reverse-dep constraints admit 2.8.0, and the merged lock file still resolves with --require-hashes for cp312/manylinux x86_64.
Runtime compatibility of the pinned requests 2.34.2 with urllib3 2.8.0 (GET + streamed read against a local HTTP server).
